cohort: 37 confirmed COVID-19 positive pregnant women of more than 28 weeks of gestation
finding: While the study found no direct evidence for vertical transmission of SARS-CoV-2, it suggests that COVID-19 infection during late pregnancy might lead to an increased incidence of caesarean deliveries and may have other maternal and neonatal impacts.
mod_finding: COVID-19 infections in late pregnancy might lead to an increased incidence of caesarean deliveries.
